labelled_transcript: Therapist. Hi there. Today we're going to talk about something that really happened to you. I'll go first and then it'll be your turn. Yesterday my phone rang at the cinema because I forgot to turn it off. Everyone looked at me. I felt really embarrassed. Okay, now it's your turn. Child. There was a fire drill. Therapist. A fire drill. Who was there? Child. Everybody. All the classes. And the teachers. Therapist. All the classes and the teachers. Where were you when the alarm went off? Child. I can't remember. Therapist. That's okay. What happened when the alarm went off? Child. It was really loud, so I put my hands on my ears. Therapist. It was really loud, so you covered your ears. How did you feel? Child. Worried. I thought it was a real fire. Therapist. You were worried it was a real fire. Lots of people feel nervous when the alarm goes. What happened next? Child. We all lined up. Mrs Khan counted us. Therapist. Mrs Khan counted you. Was everyone there? Child. Yeah. Everybody. Everybody was there. Therapist. What happened after that? Child. She said it was just practice. So we went back in. I was glad. Therapist. It was just practice, so you went back in, and you were glad. Let me say your story back to you. There was a fire drill with all the classes and the teachers. It was really loud, so you put your hands on your ears, and you were worried it was a real fire. You all lined up, and Mrs Khan counted everyone. It was just practice, so you went back in, and you felt glad. Did I get that right? Child. Yeah. Therapist. Thanks for telling me your story. You did a really great job.
